description: Full public detail for one listing: buyer_price_usd (what a buyer pays, delivery within 100 miles included), availability, condition, location, dimensions, weight, highlights, the seller's description, photo links, when it was listed, is_yours (whether it belongs to this account), and hsa_fsa_eligible (whether HSA or FSA funds can pay for it). Condition is in the sell form's spelling (New, Like New, Excellent, Very Good, Good, Fair, Poor, Used) when it is one of those grades, otherwise the seller's own words. Categories offer different grades; the ones a new listing can use are its category's condition_options from listing_resolve_category. original_price_usd is the item's retail price new, when known; a price change does not set it. Fields that are not on file come back null.

listing_id.description: The listing's numeric id, from a search result or seller_list_listings.
